sources.title: Data monetisation / third-party sharing
sources.why: Requires explicit, granular, purpose-specific consent per purpose and mandates that withdrawal be as easy as giving it.

sources.title: ePrivacy Art. 5(3) — access to terminal equipment (cookies, SDKs, trackers)
sources.why: Demands prior, GDPR-standard consent (freely given, granular) before non-essential processing, which users must be able to refuse or revoke.

sources.title: GDPR Art. 9 — health data (special category)
sources.why: Makes explicit, affirmative consent the default lawful basis for health data, and such consent is dynamically withdrawable at any time.
